## File: google-deepmind_alphafold/alphafold/notebooks/notebook_utils.py

Prompts

```
['clean and validate a single amino acid protein sequence string against standard residue types', 'clean and validate a list of amino acid protein sequences with min and max length checks', 'merge chunked MSA database search results from Stockholm and tblout files sorted by E-value', 'display a plot of per-residue non-gap amino acid counts from a deduplicated MSA', 'create zero-filled placeholder template feature arrays for a given number of templates and residues', 'test the clean_and_validate_single_sequence function to strip whitespace and validate amino acid sequences', 'test the clean_and_validate_input_sequences function to clean and validate a list of amino acid sequences', 'test the merge_chunked_msa function to merge multiple chunked MSA search results into a single alignment', 'test the show_msa_info function to print summary statistics about multiple sequence alignments', 'test the check_cell_execution_order function to verify notebook cells were executed in the correct order']
```

Usage

```
{'clean_and_validate_single_sequence': 'clean and validate a single amino acid protein sequence string against standard residue types', 'clean_and_validate_input_sequences': 'clean and validate a list of amino acid protein sequences with min and max length checks', 'merge_chunked_msa': 'merge chunked MSA database search results from Stockholm and tblout files sorted by E-value', 'show_msa_info': 'display a plot of per-residue non-gap amino acid counts from a deduplicated MSA', 'empty_placeholder_template_features': 'create zero-filled placeholder template feature arrays for a given number of templates and residues'}
```
